The defense rested its case on Tuesday, 21 May 2024, without [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]] taking the witness stand.[{n}] Attorney [[todd-blanche|Todd Blanche]] closed the defense after testimony from a former federal prosecutor who challenged the credibility of the prosecution's key witness, and Judge [[juan-merchan|Juan M. Merchan]] dismissed the jury until 28 May, when closing arguments were scheduled.[{n}] After more than four weeks of testimony, jurors were expected to begin deliberating on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records as early as the following week.[{n}] Badlands contributor [[ashe-in-america|Ashe in America]] argued that on the evidence the case should have been dismissed, that [[michael-cohen|Michael Cohen]] and [[stormy-daniels|Stormy Daniels]] should be charged with perjury, and that the attorneys who put them on the stand should be disbarred.[{n}]
Credibility challenged at the 2024 hush money trial

During the May 2024 New York hush money trial of [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]], the defense rested after calling a former federal prosecutor who challenged the credibility of the prosecution's key witness, Cohen.[{n}] Badlands contributor [[ashe-in-america|Ashe in America]] argued that Cohen and [[stormy-daniels|Stormy Daniels]] should be charged with perjury and that the prosecutors who put them on the stand — in her view knowing they would lie — should be disbarred.[{n}]

Following the close of the defense case in [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]]'s New York hush money trial in May 2024, Badlands contributor [[ashe-in-america|Ashe in America]] argued that Daniels and [[michael-cohen|Michael Cohen]] should be charged with perjury, and that the attorneys who called them as witnesses should be disbarred.[{n}]

In the 22 May 2024 Badlands News Brief, Ashe in America responded to a Colorado legislator's claim that Republicans would have jailed [[joe-biden|Joe Biden]] over hush money payments, arguing the claim assumed an underlying crime that did not exist, assumed the Biden family had never paid anyone off, and falsely presumed Republicans had the power to hold Biden accountable — pointing to [[robert-hur|Robert Hur]] and to legislation dying in the [[united-states-senate|Senate]].[{n}] She wrote that Republicans' only play was 'to wake up the people,' and distanced herself from equating Republicans with the shadow-government concept of 'white hats,' holding that 'the parties are the problem.'[{n}] She closed by saying trust in the justice system would be restored only by accountability, asking, 'Do you believe in boomerangs?'[{n}]

She also commented on [[klaus-schwab|Klaus Schwab]]'s step-back from executive management of the [[world-economic-forum|World Economic Forum]], invoking [[edward-bernays|Edward Bernays]] and the *Hunger Games* prequel to describe elite ideology, and on the Georgia primary results for [[fani-willis|Fani Willis]] and Judge [[scott-mcafee|Scott McAfee]].[{n}]

In the 22 May 2024 Badlands News Brief, GhostofBasedPatrickHenry argued that [[george-soros|George Soros]] and [[benjamin-netanyahu|Benjamin Netanyahu]] function as 'two sides of the same coin' in a controlled-opposition dynamic sustained by press kabuki that never advances past tough talk, because the object is to keep the Forever Wars going.[{n}] He contended that Saudi bilateral diplomacy, exemplified by [[mohammed-bin-salman|Mohammed bin Salman]] and the [[arab-summit-2024-bahrain|33rd Arab Summit]], had turned globalist-built institutions against their creators.[{n}]

He also disputed the 'lone-wolf' framing of the shooting of [[robert-fico|Robert Fico]], profiling [[zuzana-caputova|Zuzana Čaputová]]'s [[open-society-foundations|Open Society]] background and [[michal-simecka|Michal Šimečka]]'s pledge to block Fico from governing, and suggested Ukrainian handlers at Langley using [[operation-gladio|Operation Gladio]] networks and tactics.[{n}] On the [[protecting-americans-in-the-idf-act|Protecting Americans in the IDF Act]], he asked how the measure was not treason under U.S. Code § 2387.[{n}]
Commentary on the 2024 gasoline reserve drawdown

In the 22 May 2024 Badlands News Brief, Burning Bright argued that the [[joe-biden|Biden]] administration's liquidation of the [[northeast-gasoline-supply-reserve|Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve]] and continued drawdown of the [[strategic-petroleum-reserve|Strategic Petroleum Reserve]] — which [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]] had topped up while in office — mirrored the economic pincer facing ordinary Americans, trading long-term stability for short-term solvency.[{n}] He characterized the administration's openly stated rationale of delivering a holiday discount of a few cents per gallon as 'advertising, full stop,' and read the episode as another Devolution proof: 'Planned.'[{n}]
